blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: Finish schedules are the builder's contract. Every finish must be specific: product name, color code, size, and cross-reference to specification section. Vague entries ("paint TBD," "tiles to match existing") cause rework and disputes. Use CSI format. Include color/material samples on a separate key sheet.</Tip>
